row.evidence: Glassdoor's Employer Center users are added with the Invite Co-Workers button and removed by an Administrator; the help centre has no SCIM or SAML article and Glassdoor "no longer supports API partnerships".
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Scored as the Glassdoor for Employers Employer Center (an Indeed company). Two tiers: Free and Paid (Employer Branding Hub, which also unlocks Indeed Company Pages Premium; Contact Sales). No SCIM, no customer-IdP SAML/OIDC SSO documented (the only 'one login' is the shared Glassdoor/Indeed account sign-in), and no user API. Okta's OIN 'Glassdoor' app is SWA only (last updated Feb. 6 2023, functionality read from page markup).

plans.name: Paid (Employer Branding Hub)
plans.notes: Adds the Local Administrator role (domain-scoped admin).

scim.notes: No SCIM, SAML or provisioning documentation in the Glassdoor help centre (search 'scim': no results; 'single sign-on' returns only the shared Glassdoor/Indeed consumer login). Employer Center users are invited and removed by hand. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: Glassdoor says it no longer supports API partnerships; no user-management API is documented.

okta.notes: OIN app marks SWA only (checked items read from page markup); no SAML or SCIM.

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited from Manage Users > Invite Co-workers and removed from the same tab.
